tool_input.description: Probe FastDateFormat parsing of ISO offset pattern

result:
Not a git repo, so no diff tracking — but I only created the one test file (`FastDateParserAgentTest.java`) and removed the scratch probe files I made during exploration, so the tree only has the intended new test.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/FastDateParserAgentTest.java` with 32 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering `FastDateParser`: basic/boundary parsing, adjacent numeric field widths, two-digit-year century rollover, hour rollover (`kk`=24, `hh`=12), ISO offset and week-year patterns, overflow/mismatch/invalid-pattern errors, null-argument rejection, equals/hashCode/toString, clone semantics of `getTimeZone()`, serialization round-trip, and the Japanese Imperial locale error message. All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
